platform: CJSW 90.9 FM Digital EP and Album Jotform Submission Route
manual_review_reason: CJSW accepts recent digital EPs and albums only: at least three unique tracks, released within the last three months, MP3 only, uploaded as a complete ZIP. Singles are rejected. A human must confirm international eligibility, prepare the eligible release, review the programmer-sharing and permanent-library consent, leave the field labelled 'Should be Empty' untouched, upload the ZIP, artwork and any optional one-sheet, and submit manually. Stop if any new CAPTCHA, login, payment or platform restriction appears.

platform: CKUT 90.3 FM Global Digital and Physical Music Department Submission Route
manual_review_reason: CKUT explicitly accepts worldwide submissions and publishes music@ckut.ca for 320-kbps MP3 digital delivery, with physical CDs, cassettes, 12-inch and 7-inch vinyl also authorized. Singles are rejected; except for 7-inch vinyl, at least three distinct tracks are required and remixes do not count. A human must select an eligible release, verify encoding, determine a practical email delivery method because attachment-versus-download-link rules are not stated, include sufficient metadata and send manually. Physical media, postage and customs also require human handling.
